beats.content: Neo is asleep at his computer when the screen displays a prompt telling him to wake up.
Neo attempts to type commands but the computer outputs different characters, eventually displaying a message that the Matrix has him.
Neo presses the escape key, and the screen displays a message to follow the white rabbit, which repeats when he presses it again.
Neo rubs his eyes and sees a new message on the screen addressing him by name and mimicking a knock.
Someone knocks on the door, and Choi identifies himself from outside.
Neo opens the door partially and notes that Choi is two hours late.
Choi explains his delay was due to a woman and hands Neo an envelope containing 2,000 dollars.
Neo closes the door, retrieves a computer disk from a hollowed-out book by Baudrillard, and hands it to Choi in exchange for the money.
Choi expresses gratitude and agrees that the transaction never happened, asserting that Neo does not exist in their world.
Neo asks Choi if he has ever felt unsure whether he was awake or dreaming.
Choi attributes such feelings to mescaline and suggests Neo needs to unplug and relax, asking Dujour if they should take Neo with them.
Neo notices a small white rabbit pin on Dujour's jacket, which causes the room to tilt, and he agrees to go with them.

beats.content: Amidst a packed dwelling, Neo is by himself and senses he does not belong, at which point he becomes aware of a female gazing in his direction.
Trinity greets Neo by name and states she has been wanting to meet him for some time.
Neo asks how she knows his name and who she is.
Trinity identifies herself as Trinity, the person who cracked the I.R.S. D-Base.
Neo expresses surprise, admitting he had assumed Trinity was a man.
Trinity confirms that most men assume she is a man and refuses to leave the location, stating it is safe and she has little time.
Neo asks if Trinity was responsible for the messages on his computer.
Trinity confirms she did it and warns Neo that he is in danger and being watched.
Trinity explains that Neo is looking for an answer, not a person, and that the question driving him is what the Matrix is.
Neo asks what the Matrix is.
Trinity states that no one can be told the answer; they must see it to believe it, and that the answer is looking for Neo.
Trinity turns and disappears into the crowd, leaving Neo alone as the sound of music rises.

beats.content: Morpheus led Neo into a room filled with high-tech equipment, where Trinity, Apoc, Switch, and Cypher were present.
Morpheus inquired if the system was online, to which Apoc replied that it was almost ready.

Morpheus explained that the pill Neo took was part of a trace program designed to disrupt his input/output carrier signal to pinpoint his location.
Neo observed a cracked oval dressing mirror, which began to heal itself, with the cracks running together as if the mirror were becoming liquid.
As Neo extended a hand to make contact with the reflective pane, the liquid-like top layer absorbed his digits, which then elongated into lengthy, pliable tendrils.
Morpheus asked Neo if he had ever had a dream that felt so real, and then asked how he would know the difference between a dreamworld and the real world if he couldn't wake up.

The digits of Neo expanded, forming reflective icicles that started to liquefy. These drips flowed similarly to molten wax, traveling along his fingers and spreading over his palm, where his own visage became visible in the reflection.
Trinity reported that Neo was going into replication.
Morpheus called Tank on a cellular phone, stating that they would need the signal soon.
Neo started to panic as the mirror gel climbed up his arms and neck, causing him to tilt his head like he was sinking into the mirror.
Trinity reported that Neo was experiencing fibrillation.
Streams of mercury ran from Neo's nose.
Apoc reported that he was targeting and almost had a lock on Neo.
Trinity reported that Neo was going into arrest.
Apoc confirmed that he had a lock on Neo.
Morpheus instructed Tank to initiate the signal now.

A piercing, high-frequency electrical shriek blasted through the earpieces, causing Neo's vision to fracture and his lids to snap shut. Overcome by intense pain, his form bent backward before he was dragged into the void.
